notes: Sister property to Taita Hills Safari Resort & Spa (same operator/contract document) - see taita-hills-safari-resort-spa-2026.json. Both signed as a single Sunworld Safaris agreement.
Children under 5 are NOT permitted at Salt Lick Safari Lodge for safety reasons (structural/environmental) - unlike Taita Hills Safari Resort & Spa where under-4s are free.
Contract (Sunworld) rate is notably lower than Rack (e.g. Park View High Double: Contract $270 vs Rack $396) - roughly 30-32% off, not a uniformly round percentage across all lines.

childPolicy.raw: Under 5: NOT permitted at Salt Lick (safety). 5-11.99yrs sharing with 1-2 adults: 50% of adult sharing rate (max 3 guests/room). 5-11.99yrs in own room (min 2, max 3): 75% of adult sharing rate; under-12s should share connecting rooms subject to availability.

occupancyRules.raw: Max 3 adults, or 2 adults + 1 child. Triple rooms available (Park View only, subject to availability) - NOT possible in Waterhole View rooms. Interconnecting rooms NOT available at Salt Lick.

sanctuaryEntryFee.raw: US$40/adult, US$20/child per night (2 Jan 2026-1 Jan 2027); under 5 free.

tourLeaderPolicy.raw: 1 complimentary per 15 full-paying pax, max 3 tour leaders, pre-booked/confirmed. Groups <15: 50% of single/twin rate. All other supplements/sanctuary fees still apply.

agentFamTripRate.raw: 50% of single contracted rate (single use) or 75% of double contracted rate (double/twin) - not applicable during Christmas/Easter, request basis, subject to availability.

dayRoom.raw: 50% of double/single room rate, valid until 17:00 incl. lunch; full overnight rate charged after 17:00

oneNightPackageIncludes: WW1 Talk & Artifacts Museum visit at Taita Hills Safari Resort & Spa
extraNightPackageIncludes: Visit to Taita Hills Wildlife Education Centre
madarakaExpressTrainPackage_2026.childPolicyNote: Same strict under-5 ban applies to the train package.

optionalExtras.amount: Half day US$280, full day US$350

madarakaExpressTrainPackage_2026.trainCancellation: Train tickets non-refundable once booked/issued (100% charge, US$24/ticket/way)

policies.deposit: Full payment 30 days prior to arrival; cheques not accepted
policies.cancellation: 30-16 days: 25% loss; 15-8 days: 50% loss; 7 days-arrival: 100% loss (train package adds 60-31 days: 30% loss band)
